findings.stage_challenged: real-entity repair (DECISIVE CHECK - VERIFIED, not refuted)
findings.claim: Every named entity in the current passage is free of a real-world bearer, and the three replacement coinages are demonstrably cleaner than the names they replaced.
findings.evidence: Six independent channels, all zero for Vresfallet(s), Sladbo, Strakasen, Brantemala, Grubbfors, 'Assar Bostrand', 'Vendela Nyfeldt' and 'Hillevi Radmark'. The same channels return real bearers for the removed names: OSM lists Hyttfallet in Karlskoga and Nora (both Orebro lan), K-samsok returns 669 for Kvarnasen and 9 for Milbo. The passage names no institute, firm or publication, so no further class of entity was at risk.
findings.why: The Kerrig precedent (a kept name that turned out to be a real Slovenian metalworking firm) does not repeat here. Every name the repair 'checked and kept' was re-checked from scratch, including the two person surnames the note itself flagged as attested.

findings.claim: Every checkable factual claim in the new originality_note reproduces, including its two strongest pieces of evidence and its claim about a rejected candidate.
findings.evidence: (a) Lansstyrelsen Orebro 'Hammarby hytta' returns the note's sentence verbatim: 'Vid Hyttfallet i Hammarby har forsen dammts sedan 1500-talet och det bruk som senare vaxte fram var i drift anda fram till ar 1923.' (b) K-samsok fulltext 'Milbo' returns exactly 9 records, every itemLabel 'Skidtavling i Hille, Milbo' - count AND uniform title match. (c) K-samsok 'Kvarnasen' returns exactly 669, the note's figure; Libris independently returns the cited 'Kvarnasen : en tidigmesolitisk boplats...'. (d) The rejected candidate: a hembygd torp PDF (filer.hembygd.se/hol/uploads/.../28 Torpet Kalleberg.pdf) contains 'Till torpet Klovasen, Balinge, 1873.' - the note's exact citation. (e) The surname attestations reproduce, incl. Olof Radmark the biochemist.
findings.why: The sibling-repair precedent was an originality_note with verifiably false claims. This note is the opposite: its numbers reproduce to the digit and its quotations are verbatim. No REFUTE-grade originality claim exists.

findings.claim: The assertion that the entityfix/entityfix2 lines are the LAST records for this unit in verdicts-vfinal/ does not hold for verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl, which contains ZERO entityfix2 lines for this unit - and that is the only G-KEY leg vfinal_fold.py reads. batches/batch14/verdicts.jsonl (promote's fleet view) likewise has zero.
findings.evidence: verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl, las-b14-001 lines 16-19 executed_by 'claude-opus-4-8/G-KEY-1' (vote 1) and lines 57-60 executed_by 'claude-opus-4-8/G-KEY' (vote 2), both pre-rename; grep 'entityfix' in that file returns only elf-b14-002 rows 78-82. gates/scripts/vfinal_fold.py line 61: gkey = _last_wins(verdicts_dir / 'verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl', cid). The entityfix2 G-KEY solves exist only in verdicts-gkey-1.jsonl lines 42-45 and verdicts-gkey-2.jsonl lines 42-45. G-STEM (lines 19-22, executed_by G-STEM-entityfix2) and G-DISTRACTOR (lines 42-45, G-DISTRACTOR-entityfix2) ARE entityfix2-tagged and ARE last in their files.
findings.why: Held to minor rather than major because it is a plumbing gap with no substantive consequence: the stale resolved lines carry solver_answer B/D/A/C, verdict pass, findings [] at both votes - the same outcome as the entityfix2 re-solves, so the fold's numbers are unaffected. It is nonetheless a false freshness assertion; re-run gkey_resolve.py over the entityfix2 legs, and merge them into batches/batch14/verdicts.jsonl, before promote.

findings.stage_challenged: old-name eradication (PASS, with one intentional exception)
findings.claim: The pre-rename names are gone from passage, prompts, options, rationales and every generator_meta field EXCEPT originality_note, where they appear by design as provenance prose.
findings.evidence: Recursive scan of candidates-final/las-b14-001.json: the only string containing 'Hyttfallet', 'Hyttfallets', 'Milbo' or 'Kvarnasen' is /generator_meta/originality_note. self_blind_solve was correctly rewritten (its entity list now reads Vresfallets bruk, Sladbo, Strakasen). The renamed entities never occurred in prompts or options at all - only Bostrand and Nyfeldt appear there (q3 prompt, q3 B, q3 D), and both were kept.
findings.why: A literal 'zero survivors in generator_meta' grep would trip on the audit trail. Flagged so a future automated banned-name sweep excludes originality_note rather than raising a false positive. Old names also survive upstream in candidates/, candidates-corrected/, gen-las-long-1.json and its NOTES, which are historical stage records, not the shipped artefact.

findings.stage_challenged: byte-identity of letters and keys (PASS by structure; no pre-rename candidates-final exists on disk or in git)
findings.claim: Letters A-D in order and keys B/D/A/C are intact and coherent with all metadata; the repair's byte-identity assertion cannot be diffed directly because candidates-final/ is untracked and was overwritten in place, but it is verified indirectly and holds.
findings.evidence: git ls-files shows candidates-final/ untracked ('?? candidates-final/'), so no pre-rename baseline exists. Indirect verification: (i) the renamed strings occur in no prompt or option, so the rename could not have touched them; (ii) key_spread ['B','D','A','C'] equals the on-disk keys; (iii) planted_traps for each question cover exactly the three non-key letters; (iv) the derived gate sheets blind/, stems/ and distractor/las-b14-001.json (all mtime 18:54:51, i.e. written after candidates-final at 18:53:06) match the shipped file exactly on passage, all four prompts and all sixteen option texts, so the entityfix2 gates judged the shipping article. Note that candidates-corrected/ is NOT the pre-rename baseline: it predates a separate b14repair distractor round that rewrote q1/C and q2/B and retagged two traps (q1 C scope_shift -> surface_lexical_echo, q2 B overgeneralisation -> plausible_worldknowledge). Those edits are not rename damage.
findings.why: Prevents a future reader from mistaking the corrected-vs-final delta for damage introduced by the rename.

findings.stage_challenged: content residue carried forward from the superseded audit
findings.claim: Two pre-existing content wrinkles survive the rename untouched and should not be lost when this audit replaces the old file.
findings.evidence: (i) 'for aren 1863 till 1866 saknas hela band ... men serien tacker anda fyrtiotva ar i foljd' - 'i foljd' asserts consecutiveness while a four-year gap is stated in the same sentence; within '1800-talets andra halft' a 42-year span is arithmetically available but not a gap-free one. (ii) q4's stem says 'samma hushall kunde bedriva bada hantverken' while the passage supports only 'levererade ungefar en tredjedel ocksa tjara nagot ar'; 'nagot ar' does not establish the same-year concurrency that key C's seasonality argument presupposes.
findings.why: Neither is caused by or affected by the entity rename; both are inherited. Recorded so the tally is not silently reset to zero by this overwrite.
